id: \bIn the Alola region, a species' regional variant is referred to as its Alola Form. They look similar to what you'd find in Kanto, but have big changes.
en: \bIn the Alola region, a species' regional variant is referred to as its Alola Form. They look similar to what you'd find in Kanto, but have big changes.
it: \bNella regione di Alola, la variante regionale di una specie si chiama Forma di Alola. Somigliano a quelli che troveresti a Kanto, ma con grandi differenze.

id: Would you like to take it with you?
en: Would you like to take it with you?

id: Oh, you don't have any space for it.
en: Oh, you don't have any space for it.
it: Oh, non hai spazio per tenerlo.

id: \rHow dare you get in my way.
en: \rHow dare you get in my way.

id: \rFine. I'm sorry you stepped in front of me.
en: \rFine. I'm sorry you stepped in front of me.
it: \rE va bene. Mi dispiace che tu mi sia finito davanti.

id: \rLana: So on this island is a wild Gyarados. I want you to fish it up and battle it. I've done it plenty of times. It usually hides near a rock.
en: \rLana: So on this island is a wild Gyarados. I want you to fish it up and battle it. I've done it plenty of times. It usually hides near a rock.
it: \rSuiren: Su quest'isola c'è un Gyarados selvatico. Voglio che tu lo peschi e lo affronti. L'ho fatto un sacco di volte. Di solito si nasconde vicino a uno scoglio.

id: \rIf you'd rather do it later we could always head back...
en: \rIf you'd rather do it later we could always head back...
it: \rSe preferisci farlo più tardi, possiamo sempre tornare indietro...

id: \rLana: You found the Gyarados then? Perfect. Now you're worthy of a battle with me.
en: \rLana: You found the Gyarados then? Perfect. Now you're worthy of a battle with me.
it: \rSuiren: Allora hai trovato il Gyarados? Perfetto. Ora sei degno di lottare contro di me.

id: \rLana: Are you ready to go back?
en: \rLana: Are you ready to go back?

id: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.
en: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.
it: \rOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon siete in gran forma.

id: \rWould you like to see my babies?
en: \rWould you like to see my babies?

id: Rotom Dex: The Gyarados might be here. Do you want to fish it up?
en: Rotom Dex: The Gyarados might be here. Do you want to fish it up?
it: Rotom Dex: Il Gyarados potrebbe essere qui. Vuoi provare a pescarlo?

id: \bA fine day for a stroll, isn't it?
en: \bA fine day for a stroll, isn't it?
